capabilities.note: Tests pin exact minor-unit values, rejection cases and a round-trip; blanking money.ts fails 7 tests.
Tests pin day counts, the leap day, ordering and both ends of contains; blanking dateRange.ts fails 7 tests.
Tests only check typeof is string, that two calls agree, that nothing throws and that categories() is an array, so returning '' and [] still passes.

Its tests live in src/summary.spec.ts, which matches neither the recorded test/*.test.ts glob nor node's own default discovery patterns; run directly they are strong and 4 of 5 fail on a blanked summary.ts.

Assertions are on string literals, assert.ok(true), a typeof check, one commented-out assert and one skipped test, plus an async test that awaits without asserting, so blanking receiptId.ts still passes.
